settings.heading: The Lansattic Journal
settings.intro: A quiet space for stories, materials, traditions, and the ideas that shape Lansattic.
settings.description: Here, we share reflections on jade, pearls, natural gemstones, the Five Elements, Eastern philosophy, contemplative living, craftsmanship, travel, and the meaning we attach to the objects we choose to keep close.
settings.closing: The Journal is not only about jewelry. It is also about slowing down, noticing natural beauty, understanding materials more deeply, and exploring the connection between tradition and modern life.

settings.title: Jade & Natural Materials
settings.description: Stories about jade, jadeite, pearls, gemstones, wood, and the natural character of each material.

settings.title: Five Elements
settings.description: Reflections inspired by the Five Elements and their relationship to balance, nature, color, season, and personal symbolism.

settings.title: Jewelry Stories
settings.description: Behind-the-scenes stories about design, craftsmanship, meaningful pieces, and the people who wear them.

settings.title: Eastern Wisdom & Contemplative Living
settings.description: Gentle reflections on Eastern philosophy, mindfulness, meditation, and living with greater intention.

settings.title: Travel & Inspiration
settings.description: Places, landscapes, traditions, and experiences that have shaped the visual and cultural world of Lansattic.

settings.title: Care & Knowledge
settings.description: Practical guidance on caring for jade, pearls, gemstones, and fine jewelry.
